author: Amanda Robertson
text: Chris came out within an appropriate time and cleaned out our septic and showed us how to clean the filters. He was joyful, kind and generous. We enjoyed talking with him while he worked. A + rating! Definitely recommend! His prices are very reasonable too!

author: yby tez
text: We are so very pleased with Express Septic.  Chris answered immediately and offered to come out to locate our tank for free when one company cancelled last minute, and another company couldn't find it.  Not only did he find the needle in the hay stack quickly, he responded immediately, fixed the problem and charged a more than reasonable price to do so.  We will definitely be using Express for all our septic needs in the future.  Thank you Chris!!!

author: Brandon Paul
text: Excellent experience with Express Septic!!! Our drains were backing up and we needed help. Called late on Friday and they were there prompt and early on Saturday morning. Went the extra mile for us and we won't forget it. A well deserved 5 star rating. You earned it!!!!

author: Mostly Minimal Mama
text: Chris is incredibly knowledgeable and actually cares about his customers. His rates are the best we found and we absolutely will be having him for all of our drainage needs. Definitely recommend!

author: Superior Alarm LLC
text: Chris at Express Septic is great! He explained everything thoroughly and told us how to better maintain our septic system. Express Septic is local and I believe the best price you’re gonna find around. You won’t be sorry they do a good job
